    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if use_log_scale:
        # Apply logarithmic distance calculation
        log_num1 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num1)
        log_num2 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num2)
        distances = np.abs(log_num1 - log_num2)
        # Set distances below threshold to 0
        distances[distances < log_scale_similarity_threshold] = 0
        return distances
    
    # Convert to float if needed
    num1 = num1.astype(np_float64)
    num2 = num2.astype(np_float64)
    
    # Calculate divisor: (num1 + num2) / max_
    divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_
    
    # Use numpy division with special handling for division by zero
    distances = _numpy_div(np.abs(num1 - num2), divisor, replace_inf_with=max_)
    
    # Cap distances at max_
